AND (INSTR(PROJECT_NAME, #{keyword}) > 0 OR INSTR(FILE_NAME, #{keyword}) > 0) ) WHERE RN <= #{limit} ORDER BY RN

mapper.update: UPDATE BUSINESS_MATERIAL_INTAKE SET ERROR_CODE=ERROR_CODE || '_CLEANED' WHERE ID=#{id} AND STATUS='FAILED' AND FIELDS_JSON IS NULL AND ERROR_CODE=#{reason}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BUSINESS_MATERIAL_INTAKE (ID, ACTOR_ID, OPERATION_KEY, FILE_NAME, MEDIA_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, SHA256, STORAGE_KEY, STATUS, LEASE_TOKEN, LEASE_UNTIL, FIELDS_JSON, PARSE_METHOD, ERROR_CODE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, PROJECT_NAME, PROJECT_NO, DEPARTMENT_NAME, PROCUREMENT_TYPE, BUDGET_AMOUNT, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NAME, PROCUREMENT_METHOD, REQUIREMENT_DESCRIPTION, APPLICANT_NAME) VALUES (#{id}, #{actorId}, #{operationKey}, #{fileName}, #{mediaType}, #{fileSize}, #{sha256}, #{storageKey}, #{status}, #{leaseToken}, #{leaseUntil}, #{fieldsJson,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{parseMethod}, #{errorCode}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{projectName}, #{projectNo}, #{departmentName}, #{procurementType}, #{budgetAmount}, #{subjectCode}, #{subjectName}, #{procurementMethod}, #{requirementDescription}, #{applicantName})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT M.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_AT, ID) RN FROM BUSINESS_MATERIAL_INTAKE M WHERE STATUS = 'QUEUED' OR (STATUS = 'PROCESSING' AND LEASE_UNTIL <= #{now})) WHERE RN <= #{limit} ORDER BY RN
mapper.update: UPDATE BUSINESS_MATERIAL_INTAKE SET LEASE_UNTIL = #{until} WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'PROCESSING' AND LEASE_TOKEN = #{token}

UPDATE BUSINESS_MATERIAL_INTAKE SET STATUS = 'PROCESSING', LEASE_TOKEN = #{row.leaseToken}, LEASE_UNTIL = #{row.leaseUntil}, UPDATED_AT = #{row.updatedAt}, ERROR_CODE = NULL WHERE ID = #{row.id} AND STATUS <> 'PARSED' AND (ERROR_CODE IS NULL OR ERROR_CODE NOT IN ('MATERIAL_CALL_TIMEOUT','MATERIAL_TIME_LIMIT','MATERIAL_QUEUE_TIMEOUT','MATERIAL_CALL_TIMEOUT_CLEANED','MATERIAL_TIME_LIMIT_CLEANED','MATERIAL_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_CLEANED')) AND (STATUS <> 'PROCESSING' OR LEASE_UNTIL <= #{now})

UPDATE BUSINESS_MATERIAL_INTAKE SET STATUS = #{status}, FIELDS_JSON = #{fieldsJson,jdbcType=CLOB}, PARSE_METHOD = #{parseMethod}, ERROR_CODE = #{errorCode}, UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt}, PROJECT_NAME = #{projectName}, PROJECT_NO = #{projectNo}, DEPARTMENT_NAME = #{departmentName}, PROCUREMENT_TYPE = #{procurementType}, BUDGET_AMOUNT = #{budgetAmount}, SUBJECT_CODE = #{subjectCode}, SUBJECT_NAME = #{subjectName}, PROCUREMENT_METHOD = #{procurementMethod}, REQUIREMENT_DESCRIPTION = #{requirementDescription}, APPLICANT_NAME = #{applicantName} WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'PROCESSING' AND LEASE_TOKEN = #{leaseToken}

UPDATE BUSINESS_MATERIAL_INTAKE SET STATUS = 'PROCESSING', LEASE_TOKEN = #{row.leaseToken}, LEASE_UNTIL = #{row.leaseUntil}, UPDATED_AT = #{row.updatedAt}, ERROR_CODE = NULL WHERE ID = #{row.id} AND (STATUS = 'QUEUED' OR (STATUS = 'PROCESSING' AND LEASE_UNTIL <= #{now}))
